svg.aria-label: wireframe schematic — the app’s own layout, drawn frame by frame: the given, then each beat. given a screen's proof in two kinds — a unit test of one screen or component, a flow test crossing screens along a chosen path; beat 1: a test of either kind tags several requirements → each tagged requirement is proven only by an assertion that would fail without it, and a requirement no test tags stays Untested — a test merely existing buys no green
